## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the trigger, observable result and scope. Link the owning issue/delivery record. Keep plans and one-off acceptance evidence out of durable docs.

## Responsibilities and contracts

Identify affected suites/carriers/apps/packages, dependency direction and lifecycle owners. Review the entire architecture and update guidance only where behavior makes it inaccurate. Preserve public licenses, privacy, finite distribution and user-data boundaries.

## Validation and limitations

Record exact source/build/test/runtime evidence. Separate mechanism references, actual product behavior, native-platform and distribution acceptance. State deferred failures and unimplemented behavior explicitly.

## Delivery

Use an independent topic worktree and PR into refactor/odsuite. Verify base/head and checks; strict squash only. Integration into feature/motion, changes to main and any publication require their separate acceptance and authorization.
